claim: The operator formalism of quantum mechanics can be inferred from the concept of uncertainty together with the indistinguishability of identical particles, without additional hypotheses.
falsifier: The derivation can be checked by reconstructing the operator formalism from uncertainty and indistinguishability postulates and verifying that the resulting operators reproduce standard commutation relations.

conditions: the derivation uses only the uncertainty concept
the derivation uses the corollary of indistinguishability of identical particles
exclusions: Evidence is limited to the reported theoretical derivation; transfer beyond the sampled system is unestablished.

title: Quantum-mechanical operator formalism–derivation of the operator theorem
